title: Verilay Job History Credential v1
description: Credential asserting that a company registered in Verilay attested to the subject's employment: which company, in what role, over which dates. This is the credential that gates review submission, so companyId is the join key between the credential and the reviews registry. Merklized: no iden3_serialization directive, every subject field is addressable through the merklization root.

companyId.title: Company ID
companyId.description: The attesting company's Verilay account user_uuid, in canonical lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hyphenated form. This is the identifier verilay-user-service exposes on the public business record and the one the reviews registry keys on — not a company name, domain or display label. String, so it supports equality and set-membership queries ($eq, $in, $nin) only.

role.title: Role
role.description: Job title the company attested to, as free text, e.g. "Senior Backend Engineer". Display and review-template use; string, so equality and set-membership queries only.

employedFrom.title: Employed From
employedFrom.description: First day of the employment period, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20210301. Integer encoding is what makes tenure and date-window checks expressible as on-chain range queries.

employedTo.title: Employed To
employedTo.description: Last day of the employment period, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD. Optional: absent means the employment had not ended when the company attested. A policy that needs "employment has ended" must handle absence explicitly — claimPathNotExists is part of the queryHash for exactly this case.
